name: altimateguide-agent-mcp
description: Submit a software tool to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review, then upgrade it to a dofollow listing.
long_description:
Lets an AI agent submit a software tool (name, URL, description, categories, features, pros/cons, pricing) to the Altimateguide directory for editorial review. The listing is queued as pending — nothing is published automatically.

The fastest route to a dofollow link is the paid listing: upgrade_listing with path 'paid' returns a Dodo checkout URL, and the link becomes dofollow once payment is verified server-side (reviewed within 2 business days, nothing to install). Free alternatives: SayAbout.Us wall (reviewed within 2 business days) and Altimateguide badge (5-7 business days). Free no-verification listings stay nofollow and are reviewed within 30 days.

Tools: start_login / complete_login (email OTP → token), start_agentid_login / complete_agentid_login, list_categories, check_duplicate, submit_tool, get_submission, update_listing, get_listing_stats, upgrade_listing (paid / sayabout / badge). Resources include altimateguide://listing-paths with current prices, review times and the recommended path. Supply an account API token (from https://altimateguide.com/account), or mint one at runtime with complete_login.

agent_token.title: Altimateguide API token
agent_token.description: Optional. Create one at https://altimateguide.com/account (Agent & API access), or mint one at runtime with the complete_login tool.
